material_omissions: Jia Chong separately suspected Zhong Hui and secretly warned Sima Zhao.
The explanation that Zhong Hui’s army was much larger and that Sima Zhao’s campaign was really aimed at controlling Zhong Hui is omitted.
Cui夫人’s stated reason for dying alongside Liu Chen is omitted, weakening the relationship-based motivation.
The report informing Zhong Hui that Sima Zhao had reached Chang’an is omitted, weakening the final causal transition.
distortions: “领兵复汉” presents Jiang Wei as actively leading a restoration, whereas the original only gives him a restoration plan and says Zhong Hui lets him continue commanding troops.
language_problems: “领兵复汉” is semantically ambiguous and reads like an accomplished action.
The text exceeds the stated 182-CJK-character maximum, at 184 characters.
